description: Figure 6 presents a breakdown of token resolution for FedHLM, categorizing tokens by their source: Local, P2P, and LLM. The chart consists of three slices, representing Low, Medium, and High degrees of non-iidness. The “Low” slice, colored light blue, occupies approximately 94.5% of the chart. The “Medium” slice, colored light orange, represents roughly 3.9% of the chart. Finally, the “High” slice, colored dark orange, accounts for approximately 1.6% of the chart. The chart includes a legend identifying each slice’s color and corresponding token source. Percentage labels are displayed directly within each slice. The slices are visually ordered from largest to smallest, corresponding to decreasing non-iidness levels.
